run_migrate_imports_dry_run: run a dry run of migrate_imports.py on a directory to preview import path changes
run_migrate_imports_execute: run migrate_imports.py with --execute to apply import path replacements in a directory
run_migrate_imports_single_file: run migrate_imports.py on a single Python or YAML file to replace outdated import paths
refactor_import_paths: refactor Python files to replace fairchem.experimental.foundation_models imports with fairchem.core equivalents
review_import_mapping: review the import path mapping dictionary to understand which modules have been migrated
